part1.title: Introduction and Interview
part1.instructions: I'd like to ask you some questions about technology and how you communicate.
questions: How often do you use your mobile phone?
What do you use your phone for mostly?
Do you prefer to communicate by phone or text message?
How has technology changed the way people communicate?
Do you think people spend too much time on their phones?

part2.title: Individual Long Turn
part2.duration: 3-4 minutes total (1 min prep + 2 min speaking)

cueCard.title: Describe a piece of technology that is important to you
points: What this technology is
How long you have had it
How you use it in your daily life
And explain why it is important to you
cueCard.notes: You will have 1 minute to prepare and 1-2 minutes to speak.

part3.title: Two-way Discussion
part3.instructions: Now let's discuss the role of technology in society.
questions: How do you think technology has changed people's lives?
What are the advantages and disadvantages of modern technology?
Do you think children should learn to use technology from an early age?
How might technology change in the future?
Are there any negative effects of people using technology too much?
Should there be limits on how much technology children use?

modelAnswer.part2: I'd like to talk about my laptop computer, which has become incredibly important to me over the past few years. I bought this laptop about three years ago when I started university, and since then it has become an essential part of my daily routine. I use it for many different purposes throughout the day. Primarily, I use it for my studies - writing essays, researching topics online, and attending virtual classes. I also use it for entertainment, such as watching movies, listening to music, and staying in touch with friends through social media and video calls. Additionally, I use it for practical tasks like online banking, shopping, and planning trips. This laptop is extremely important to me because it connects me to almost everything I need in my life. Without it, I wouldn't be able to complete my university work effectively, and I would feel quite isolated from my friends and family who live far away. It's also given me access to endless learning opportunities through online courses and educational videos. In many ways, my laptop has become like a window to the world, allowing me to access information, entertainment, and relationships that would otherwise be difficult to maintain.

part2.title: Individual Long Turn

part2.topic: Describe a skill you would like to learn

cueCard.title: Describe a skill you would like to learn

Why you want to learn it

part3.title: Two-way Discussion
part3.instructions: Let's discuss education and learning new skills.
questions: Why is it important for people to continue learning throughout their lives?
What's the best way to learn a new skill?
Do you think practical skills or academic knowledge is more important?
How has education changed in recent years?
Should employers provide training for their workers?
What role should governments play in education?

modelAnswer.part2: I would really like to learn how to play the guitar. This is something I've been thinking about for a long time, but I've never actually taken the time to start learning. I want to learn the guitar because I love music and I think it would be a wonderful way to express myself creatively. When I listen to music, I often imagine myself playing along, and I think it would be incredibly satisfying to be able to create music myself. To learn this skill, I would probably start by taking some online lessons or finding a local teacher. I know there are many excellent resources available on the internet, including video tutorials and apps that can help beginners. I would also need to buy a guitar, which I've been saving money for. I think I would practice for at least thirty minutes every day, because consistency is important when learning a new skill. Learning to play the guitar would benefit me in several ways. First, it would be a great hobby that I could enjoy in my free time. Second, it would help me develop patience and discipline, as learning any musical instrument requires dedication. Finally, it would give me a sense of accomplishment and boost my confidence. I think music is a universal language that brings people together, and being able to play would allow me to connect with others in a meaningful way.

modelAnswer.part2: One of my favorite places in nature is a small park near my home. This park is located about a ten-minute walk from where I live, and it's a peaceful green space in the middle of the city. The park has tall trees that provide shade during hot summer days, beautiful flower gardens that bloom in spring, and a small pond where ducks and other birds come to rest. There are also walking paths that wind through the park, and several benches where people can sit and relax. I visit this park regularly, usually in the early morning or late afternoon when it's not too crowded. When I'm there, I like to take long walks along the paths, breathing in the fresh air and enjoying the natural surroundings. Sometimes I bring a book and sit on one of the benches to read. Other times, I just sit quietly and observe the birds and squirrels that live in the park. I enjoy spending time in this park because it offers me a peaceful escape from the busy city life. Being surrounded by nature helps me relax and clear my mind. It's a place where I can think clearly and feel connected to the natural world. The park also reminds me of the importance of preserving green spaces in urban areas, as they provide essential benefits for both people and wildlife.

modelAnswer.part2: One healthy habit that I've developed over the past year is going for a morning walk every day. I started this habit when I realized I was spending too much time sitting at a desk, both at work and at home. I decided I needed to be more active, so I began waking up thirty minutes earlier each morning to go for a walk around my neighborhood. At first, it was difficult to get up early, but after a few weeks, it became a natural part of my routine. Now I look forward to my morning walks because they help me start the day feeling energized and positive. During my walk, I enjoy the quiet streets, the fresh morning air, and the opportunity to observe the neighborhood coming to life. I usually walk for about thirty minutes, which gives me time to think about my plans for the day and mentally prepare for whatever challenges I might face. This habit has helped me in many ways. Physically, I feel stronger and more energetic throughout the day. Mentally, it helps me reduce stress and improve my mood. I also sleep better at night because I'm more active during the day. I think this habit is important because it shows that small changes can make a big difference in your overall health and wellbeing. It doesn't require special equipment or a gym membership - just the commitment to take care of yourself every day.

modelAnswer.part2: I'd like to describe a traditional dance festival I attended last year in my city. The festival took place in the main square during the summer, and it lasted for three days. It was organized to celebrate our cultural heritage and bring the community together. The event featured performances by dance groups from different regions, each showing their unique traditional dances. There were also stalls selling traditional crafts, food, and clothing. What made this festival special was the variety of performances. Some dances were very energetic and fast-paced, while others were slow and graceful. The dancers wore beautiful traditional costumes in bright colors, and the music was played live by musicians using traditional instruments. I particularly enjoyed watching a group of young dancers who had learned traditional dances from their grandparents. The festival attracted people of all ages, from young children to elderly people, and everyone seemed to be enjoying themselves. I found this event very meaningful because it helped me appreciate my cultural heritage more. It also showed me how important it is to preserve these traditions for future generations. The atmosphere was wonderful - there was a real sense of community and pride in our culture.

modelAnswer.part2: Last year, I saved up to buy a new smartphone, which was quite expensive for me. I needed a new phone because my old one was very slow and the battery didn't last long. It was difficult to use for work and staying in touch with friends. I decided to buy a good quality phone that would last for several years. To save money for it, I stopped buying coffee from cafes every day and started making coffee at home instead. I also reduced spending on entertainment and put aside a small amount of money each month. It took me about six months to save enough money. When I finally bought the phone, I felt very proud of myself for achieving this goal. The new phone has a much better camera, which I really enjoy using for taking photos. It's also much faster, which makes my work easier. I use it for many things - checking emails, video calls with family, listening to music, and taking photos. I'm very happy with this purchase because it has improved my daily life significantly. It was worth the wait and the effort to save money. I learned that if you really want something, you can achieve it by planning and being patient.
